segments.text: Short bursts of high-intensity exercise dramatically improves VO2 max. VO2 max measures how efficiently your body uses oxygen during exercise. >> It turns out VO2 max is one of the strongest predictors of longevity.

>> Improve your VO2 max, which is correlated with all [music] sorts of important metrics related to health span, performance, and lifespan. >> For each unit [music] that you improve it, that is associated with a 45-day extension of life [music] expectancy. >> High VO2 max is consistently associated with lower risk of cardiovascular [music] disease and death. Conversely, lower VO2 max is a powerful mortality predictor. In a large exercise treadmill cohort, adults in the lowest 25th percentile had about a five-times higher

risk of all-cause mortality compared with those in the top 2%. >> So, if your VO2 max is 60, walking 2 mph is no problem for you. If your VO2 max is 20, that's going to feel pretty difficult. >> The higher your VO2 max goes, the more it seems to preserve all-cause mortality.
>> I aim for 75 minutes of high-intensity cardio each week. Yes, that's a lot, but remember, start where you can [music] and build over time.
